snippet.title: Amiga 500 Longplay [022] King's Quest II: Romancing The Throne
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Ironclaw

Seems like full 185 points in the Amiga version is not possible, weird.

I followed this video: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_jjUaeG9YTw and when he got points, I got points, except at the very end. He gave the lion the meat and went from 173 to 177, same for me. He enters the final room and gets to 182 points, so do I. Then in the marriage scene, he gets 185, I get nothing. It has nothing to do with me kissing the girl first, I tried with and without. For some reason the marriage scene in the Amiga version doesn't give the last 3 points. It's not a bad cracked version either as I used the SPS (.ipf) disks. Someone else did a longplay of the Amiga version and also ended on 182 points. -
